**Star Rating Row Verification: 10/10**

All 5 cards in the "Featured examples" rail render the star rating row correctly with consistent structure:

| Card | Stars | Rating | Reviews | Sold | Status |

| **SaaS Launch Page** | ★★★★☆ | 4.8 | (80) | 425 sold | ✅ Rendered |

| **Sales Dashboard** | ★★★★☆ | 4.9 | (64) | 395 sold | ✅ Rendered |
| **Salon Booking System** | ★★★★☆ | 4.9 | (78) | 469 sold | ✅ Rendered |
| **Accounting SaaS Platform** | ★★★★☆ | 4.6 | (22) | 325 sold | ✅ Rendered |

**Visual Bug Check:** None detected. All rating rows display with:
- Proper gold/yellow star icons (4 filled, 1 empty)
- Numeric rating value in bold
- Parenthetical review count
- "sold" count suffix
- Consistent vertical alignment across all cards
- Correct text hierarchy (rating > reviews > sales)

The component renders identically on each card without overflow, clipping, or alignment issues.
